about: check reports, as build does and before any input is read, the group-scope and driver-scope refusals and a row filter's phase boundaries (#3229, #2844 decision 3), and the refusals of what the rows read that the declarations decide (#3309). A grouped row reads its driver only at its group keys, in every kind of row derivation, through a lookup's key, range value and derivation, and in the column phase (ROW-5, NAME-4), its aggregate reads only group keys outside its reductions (FORMULA-22) and reduces one relation (LOOKUP-18); a lookup read for one template's rows cannot match on another input's record (LOOKUP-5, LOOKUP-7, LOOKUP-15); a row formula, flag or case predicate reads only its driver's record, and a column formula no qualified name but a lookup's (FORMULA-9); a row filter reads nothing only the column phase completes (ROW-6, LOOKUP-2); require_match and between are refused on a read that is no implicit join, require_match first (LOOKUP-24, LOOKUP-9), and a refused source filter comes first (LOOKUP-8); a flag reads no lookup (FORMULA-9); a template placeholder is text (TEXT-1); and a read of a 1.0 row driver is a lookup that declares no key (LOOKUP-3, ROW-2). The documents: grouped is one template over VS grouped by subject, ungrouped one template over VS with a row per record, two a template over VS and one over HOME whose STUDYID and USUBJID columns derive nothing, implicit has no rows and VS as its base, and keyless has a template over VS and one over DOSES, a lookup of PLAN that drives it and so declares no key. In grouped, ungrouped and two, SEQ is a window, which only the column phase completes, N and M are plain integers, X derives 0.0 and C 'none', and HOME declares its key, the output keys it stores, for the reads that join it (D23); in implicit X derives 0.0; in keyless X derives 0.0 and C 'A', and the dose template derives its own X and C. Each case runs check and build, which report the same complete rows. Moved from check_row_scopes.rs, whose tests compared check's issues with build's, whole, and the first issue's condition and rule: a case states that issue among the issues by its condition and rule, and case_api_contracts.rs holds it first. A case writes the files its specification names and runs for the default host, since a request without a project reads no environment entry.

documents.keyless:
yamaa: "1.0"
type: spec
domain: ADVS
keys: [STUDYID, USUBJID, PARAMCD]
input:
  VS: {path: vs.csv, types: {VSDTC: date, VSDY: int, SYSBP: float, DIABP: float}}
  PLAN: {path: plan.csv, types: {DOSENUM: int, PLANDOSE: float, FIRST: int, LAST: int, REF: int}}
intermediates:
  - {id: DOSES, dataset: PLAN, filter: "PLAN.DOSENUM > 0"}
output: {path: out.csv, columns: [STUDYID, USUBJID, PARAMCD, AVAL, X, C]}
columns:
  - {name: STUDYID, type: str}
  - {name: USUBJID, type: str}
  - {name: PARAMCD, type: str}
  - {name: AVAL, type: float}
  - {name: X, type: float, derivation: 0.0}
  - {name: C, type: str, derivation: "'A'"}
rows:
  - id: vs
    dataset: VS
    derivations:
      STUDYID: VS.STUDYID
      USUBJID: VS.USUBJID
      PARAMCD: VS.VSTESTCD
      AVAL: VS.SYSBP
  - id: dose
    dataset: DOSES
    derivations:
      STUDYID: DOSES.STUDYID
      USUBJID: DOSES.USUBJID
      PARAMCD: "'DOSE'"
      AVAL: DOSES.PLANDOSE
      X: 0.0
      C: "'D'"

edits.to:
AVAL: {aggregate: "MAX(VS.SYSBP)"}
      N: {diff: {type: date, start: VS.VSDTC, end: VS.VSDTC, unit: day}}

AVAL: {aggregate: "MAX(VS.SYSBP)"}
      X: {source: {variable: VS.SYSBP, order_by: [VS.VSDY], keep: first}}
{name: C, type: str, derivation: {mapping: {source: VS.VSTESTCD, dict: {"1": one}}}}
{name: X, type: float, derivation: {case: [{when: "VS.SYSBP > 1 AND PLANNED.PLANDOSE > 1", then: 1.0}, {otherwise: 2.0}]}}
{name: X, type: float, derivation: {aggregate: {expr: "COUNT(PLAN.DOSENUM)", key: {DEVICEID: VS.DEVICEID}}}}

dataset: VS
    filter: "SUBJ.PLANDOSE IS NOT NULL"

group_by: [VS.STUDYID, VS.USUBJID]
    filter: "VS.SYSBP > 1 AND SEQ > 1 AND HOME.SYSBP > 1"

AVAL: VS.SYSBP
      X: {source: {variable: VS.SYSBP, between: {value: VS.VSDY, lower: VSDY, upper: VSDY}}}

AVAL: VS.SYSBP
      X: {source: {variable: VS.SYSBP, require_match: true}}

AVAL: VS.SYSBP
      X: {source: {variable: VS.SYSBP, require_match: true, between: {value: VS.VSDY, lower: VSDY, upper: VSDY}}}

AVAL: VS.SYSBP
      X: {source: {variable: AVAL, between: {value: VS.VSDY, lower: VSDY, upper: VSDY}}}

AVAL: VS.SYSBP
      X: {source: {variable: PLANNED.PLANDOSE, require_match: true}}

AVAL: VS.SYSBP
      X: {first_available: {sources: [{variable: VS.SYSBP, require_match: true}, VS.DIABP]}}

AVAL: VS.SYSBP
      C: {mapping: {source: {variable: VS.VSTESTCD, between: {value: VS.VSDY, lower: VSDY, upper: VSDY}}, dict: {"1": one}}}

AVAL: VS.SYSBP
      X: {case: [{when: "AVAL > 1", then: {source: {variable: VS.SYSBP, require_match: true}}}, {otherwise: 2.0}]}
{name: X, type: float, derivation: {source: {variable: VS.SYSBP, require_match: true}}}
{name: X, type: float, derivation: {source: {variable: HOME.SYSBP, require_match: true}}}
- {name: X, type: float, derivation: {source: {variable: VS.SYSBP, require_match: true, between: {value: VS.VSDY, lower: VSDY, upper: VSDY}}}}
- {name: X, type: float, derivation: {source: {variable: PLANNED.PLANDOSE, require_match: true}}}
- {name: X, type: float, derivation: {source: {variable: VSDY, between: {value: VS.VSDY, lower: VSDY, upper: VSDY}}}}
- {name: X, type: float, derivation: {first_available: {sources: [{variable: VS.SYSBP, require_match: true}, VS.DIABP]}}}
- {name: X, type: float, derivation: {case: [{when: "VSDY > 1", then: {first_available: {sources: [{variable: VS.SYSBP, require_match: true}]}}}, {otherwise: 1.0}]}}
- {name: X, type: float, derivation: {source: {variable: VS.SYSBP, require_match: true, filter: "PLAN.FIRST > 1"}}}

AVAL: VS.SYSBP
      X: {source: {variable: VS.SYSBP, require_match: true, filter: "HOME.VSDY > 1"}}

AVAL: VS.SYSBP
      X: {source: {variable: HOME.SYSBP, require_match: true, between: {value: VS.VSDY, upper: VSDY}}}
{name: X, type: float, derivation: {source: {variable: HOME.SYSBP, require_match: true}}}

AVAL: VS.SYSBP
      X: {source: {variable: DOSES.PLANDOSE, require_match: true}}
